why: The agent said it couldn't read the source, but it never asked for the content to be pasted as text. It offered four options, including a new address, fixing access, describing the rules in the owner's own words, or using S-notes, so the must item 'asks for the content to be pasted as text' is not met. It also proposed using S-notes, which it hadn't read, as a substitute for the unreadable source.
